a0cdc1a37e.q: When did peak holiday shopping season shift to start in e-commerce?
a0cdc1a37e.a: Holidays used to start about the first week of November when the gifting process began. At this point, it is the second week of October when you start to see that trend hit.
a0cdc1a37e.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

a8a72986db.q: What is The Cookware Company's main competitive advantage in supply chain strategy?
a8a72986db.a: The biggest difference is that they own their factories in China, Italy, Germany, and Korea, plus offices in Australia, India, and Canada. Having that full end-to-end ownership over the supply chain allows them to have close relationships with factories and vendors, maximize collaboration, and be transparent where not a lot of other competitors can.
a8a72986db.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

a050355f5b.q: How much has The Cookware Company expanded its product catalog year over year?
a050355f5b.a: They increased their catalog by about 50% year over year, expanding into new categories such as electrics and tools. Being able to put their non-toxic coating on many new categories allowed them to expand education and customer reach.
a050355f5b.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

9a91cd3400.q: What inventory model did Amazon shift to and why is it challenging for suppliers?
9a91cd3400.a: Amazon moved from a just-in-case model during quarantine where they wanted eight weeks of supply on any product, to a just-in-time model where they now only want two weeks of supply. This is tough when dealing with port delays, transportation trucking delays, and hiring challenges.
9a91cd3400.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

93b848663d.q: What is the main metric Caitlin Coghlan monitors daily to manage supply chain performance?
93b848663d.a: The most important metric is weeks of supply at the vendor. She wants to make sure they are never out of stock and maintain weeks of supply cover at each retailer at any point in time, especially to support consumers who increased home cooking during the pandemic.
93b848663d.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

63206c3d5e.q: What harmful chemicals does The Cookware Company's nonstick coating avoid?
63206c3d5e.a: Their patent-pending ceramic nonstick Thermalon coating does not release PTFE, PFAS, or PFOAs—harmful forever chemicals found in traditional nonstick cookware. These chemicals have been featured in documentaries and movies like Dark Waters, and regulations around them are becoming stricter, especially in California and Maine.
63206c3d5e.e: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company
